## YYYY-MM-DD - Mitigate Reverse Tabnabbing
**Vulnerability:** External markdown links generated by Kramdown inline attributes `{:target="_blank"}` without `rel="noopener noreferrer"` create reverse tabnabbing vulnerabilities.
**Learning:** The generated HTML pages allowed newly opened tabs to have access to the original page's `window.opener` object, potentially allowing phishing or malicious redirects.
**Prevention:** Always append `rel="noopener noreferrer"` when using `target="_blank"` for external links to isolate the new tab's browsing context.
